title: The support of ∂Q₀ lies in the union of the closed faces of the representation
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let s be a finite set of index pairs p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin n → Fin P and b : Fin P → ℤ, and let u_p : Euclid n → ℝ be arbitrary functions. Let Q₀ be an n-current on ℝ^P (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with Q₀(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} u_p(y)·ω(Φ_p y)(e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}) dy for every test n-form ω. Here Q₁ = (0,1)ⁿ, Φ_p(y) = b + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} and e_l = EuclideanSpace.single l 1. Then every x ∈ spt ∂Q₀ is of the form x = Φ_q(y) for some q ∈ s and some y in the closed cube [0,1]ⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (u : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (Q₀ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q₀ ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → ∀ x ∈ Q₀.boundary.support, ∃ q ∈ s, ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ 1) ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) = x
